about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Tim Burchett

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRICE GOUGING BY BIG OIL COMPANIES
statements.title: PRICE GOUGING BY BIG OIL COMPANIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to voice my concerns on the rising price of diesel fuel.
Price gouging by greedy oil companies is causing hardworking Americans to struggle to fill their tanks.
Refiners typically make a profit of around $15 per barrel, or roughly 35 cents per gallon.
That is why I am introducing legislation to implement export control measures on American diesel.
American companies should prioritize American consumers and keep American diesel in America.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOVERNMENT AUDIT AND ACCOUNTABILITY OF FEDERALLY FUNDED STATE- ADMINISTERED PROGRAMS ACT
statements.title: GOVERNMENT AUDIT AND ACCOUNTABILITY OF FEDERALLY FUNDED STATE- ADMINISTERED PROGRAMS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank my good friend Representative Ro Khanna for his support in rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse, and I urge my colleagues to pass this bipartisan piece of legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AIRMEN CERTIFICATE ACCESSIBILITY ACT
statements.title: AIRMEN CERTIFICATE ACCESSIBILITY ACT
sentences: I rise today in support of H.R. 2247, the Airmen Certificate Accessibility Act.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this important piece of legislation.
I will also thank Noah Hooton in my office who did all of the heavy lifting on that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the SAVE America Act will block illegal immigrants and noncitizens from voting.
Unfortunately, there is a lot of misinformation out there being spread by the media and my friends across the aisle.
This SAVE America Act puts in place safeguards, Mr. Speaker, to prevent noncitizens from abusing our democratic process.
United States citizens should be the people choosing our elected leaders, not illegal immigrants.
This legislation codifies President Trump's executive action to secure our voter registration process, which has been a key platform of President Trump this term.
We need to have the guts to stand up and protect our dadgum election, Mr. Speaker, and that means we need to pass the SAVE America Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REVEREND HAROLD MIDDLEBROOK POST OFFICE BUILDING
statements.title: REVEREND HAROLD MIDDLEBROOK POST OFFICE BUILDING
sentences: I noted that Dr. Middlebrook and his bride were not sitting at that head table, and I said: No, my wife and I will sit over here off to the side.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support this.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REQUEST TO CONSIDER H.R. 4405, EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
statements.title: REQUEST TO CONSIDER H.R. 4405, EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent that the Committee on the Judiciary be discharged from further consideration of the bill (H.R. 4405) to require the Attorney General to release all documents and records in possession of the Department of Justice relating to Jeffrey Epstein, and for other purposes, and ask for its immediate consideration in the House.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DC CRIMINAL REFORMS TO IMMEDIATELY MAKE EVERYONE SAFE ACT
statements.title: DC CRIMINAL REFORMS TO IMMEDIATELY MAKE EVERYONE SAFE ACT
sentences: The revolving door of justice ends today.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill, which will ensure just that.
We will restore D.C. to become the shining city on the hill that our Founders envisioned it to be.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SANCTION SEA PIRATES ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SANCTION SEA PIRATES ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 1998, the Sanction Sea Pirates Act, introduced by my dear friend Representative Jackson.
I support this legislation and reserve the balance of my time.

Mr. Speaker, I urge the body to pass the Sanction Sea Pirates Act and send an unmistakable message: The United States of America stands firmly against sea piracy and is committed to ensuring freedom of navigation against crime in the high seas.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
sentences: TVA is a congressionally chartered American public power company that provides electricity to over 10 million people in Tennessee and six surrounding States.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the bipartisan Tennessee Valley Authority Transparency Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to pass this bipartisan bill and restore public trust in TVA.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to address this body on the issue of stock trading by Members of Congress.
Why does Congress think we are above the law?
That is why I introduced the End Congressional Stock Trading Act to level the playing field and restore public trust in Congress.
President Trump said that if my colleagues pass the bill banning stock trading for Members of Congress, he would sign it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE FIRST 100 DAYS
statements.title: THE FIRST 100 DAYS
sentences: Under President' Trumps leadership, he has successfully closed the southern border.

For the past 4 years, our country has been invaded by illegal aliens, many of whom are on the terrorist watch list, members of the Taliban, members of the Chinese Communist Party, not to mention MS-13, gangbangers, human traffickers, and fentanyl distributors.
Under President Trump's leadership, the border is now completely shut down.

That means making sweeping reforms that may actually involve some sacrifice, like passing a bill that I have--a shameless plug--End Congressional Stock Trading Act, which would level the playing field and help restore America's faith in Congress once again.
There is no reason in the world, Mr. Speaker, that we are individually trading stocks.
I do not trade any individual stocks.
President Trump said if Congress passed a bill banning stock trading for Members of this body, he would sign it.
I sure as heck know that is what I will do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ABREGO GARCIA
statements.title: ABREGO GARCIA
sentences: Where were you when Laken Riley and many other Americans were slaughtered by illegal aliens who were allowed into our country under your open-border policies?

In court documents, his wife even said: ``At this point, I am afraid to be close to him.'' She goes on to say: ``I have multiple photos, videos of how violent he can be . . . '' When Democrats grandstand on the deportation of a wife-beating El Salvadorian, MS-13 gang member and chant ``Bring him home,'' I have good news for you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEANING OF RELIGIOUS FREEDOM
statements.title: MEANING OF RELIGIOUS FREEDOM
sentences: I remember my father had a Bible verse on his mirror that said if you deny me before man, I will deny you before the gates of Heaven.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INCREDIBLE RETURN OF MR. MIKE KEITH AS THE NEXT "VOICE OF THE VOLS"
statements.title: INCREDIBLE RETURN OF MR. MIKE KEITH AS THE NEXT "VOICE OF THE VOLS"
sentences: It is not in my notes, but I will note that I did throw out the first pitch one time, and they said it was incredibly accurate and incredibly fast.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY SALARY TRANSPARENCY ACT
statements.title: TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY SALARY TRANSPARENCY ACT
sentences: The Tennessee Valley Authority is an American public power company providing electricity to over 10 million people in Tennessee and six surrounding States.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the TVA Salary Transparency Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ILLEGITIMATE COURT COUNTERACTION ACT
statements.title: ILLEGITIMATE COURT COUNTERACTION ACT
sentences: H.R. 23 is very clear: The International Criminal Court, the ICC, don't believe Israel has the right to defend itself from terrorists or those that threaten to destroy Israel's way of life.
The United States and Israel are not members of the ICC for good reason and without accident.
These decisions by the ICC are reckless, and they not only put Israel at risk, they put Americans at risk as well.
The ICC prosecutor, Karim Khan, has made a parody of justice, and he needs to find his place or we will help him find it.

I know when I get back to the office, I am going to get texts or contacts from people saying that my AIPAC handler told me to do this, and I will probably get my AIPAC handler in trouble, but I don't even know who the heck he or she is.
I fully support H.R. 23, and I look forward to passing it here shortly.
